facts.statement: To celebrate the kick-off of the World Cup, Referee Ruby appears in a video guide that previews new World Cup items and shows her on a soccer field.
facts.quote: Ref Ruby gets in tune with her inner soccer star! Preview some new World Cup items and join Ruby on the soccer field!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?: Ref Ruby's Video Guide to the World Cup
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (captured June 2010) announcing a video guide in which Referee Ruby celebrates the kick-off of the World Cup. The video previews new World Cup items and shows Ruby on a soccer field. The post gives no item names, prices or other numbers.
